claims.claim: Export of services by an osek murshe is zero-rated (0% VAT) under Section 30 of the Israeli VAT Law, legally distinct from exempt (patur, Sec 31). In the Morning API a 0% line is set via the income-row vatRate field (decimal 0), not a vatType value. The DOCUMENT-level enum DocumentVatType is 0=Default, 1=Exempt, 2=Mixed; the INCOME-ROW enum is a different one, ItemVatType, where 0=Default, 1=Included (VAT included in price), 2=Exempt. Hebrew: יצוא שירותים חייב במע"מ בשיעור אפס לפי סעיף 30 לחוק מס ערך מוסף, להבדיל מעסקה פטורה לפי סעיף 31.

claims.claim: The Morning API exposes POST /suppliers and POST /expenses. An expense created with an attached file first becomes an expense draft that must be approved before it counts as an actual expense; an expense created without a file is created immediately.
claims.raw_snippet: With a file (such as a receipt or invoice) - the upload first becomes an expense draft. Review the draft, then approve it to turn it into a regular expense. A draft is simply a pending expense waiting for your approval; until then, it isn't counted as an actual expense.

claims.claim: The allocation-number regime began in May 2024. The full threshold schedule (before VAT) is NIS 25,000 from May 2024, NIS 20,000 from January 2025, NIS 10,000 from January 2026, and NIS 5,000 from June 2026.
Independent corroboration of the same four-step allocation-number schedule from the start of the reform in May 2024.
The Israel Invoices model came into force in May 2024, so documents dated before that never required an allocation number.

claims.claim: An allocation number is required only when all four conditions hold: the amount exceeds the threshold in force; the invoice includes a VAT component (zero-rated invoices and invoices covering only exempt transactions are excluded); the recipient is an osek murshe; and the recipient requested one.
One of the cumulative conditions is that the invoice recipient is an osek murshe.
The allocation number issued by the Tax Authority is 9 digits.

The legacy API-key track's sandbox base is https://sandbox.d.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1; POSTing to /account/token there returns errorCode 2014 for bad key data, the same shape production returns, confirming the host is live and serves the legacy auth endpoint.
The allocation number is exposed by the API as `allocationNumber`, documented on Document, UpdatedDocument, Expense and ExpenseRequest.
claims.raw_snippet: Allocation Number issued by the Israeli Tax Authority

claims.claim: Section 47(a) of the VAT Law gives only an osek murshe the right to issue a tax invoice, and obliges him to do so at the buyer's demand. An osek patur therefore cannot issue type 305 or type 320, since 320 is a tax invoice with a receipt attached.

claims.claim: ItemVatType, the income-row enum, is 0 default (VAT added based on business type), 1 included (VAT included in price), 2 exempt. It is a different enum from the document-level DocumentVatType (0 default, 1 exempt, 2 mixed).
PaymentTerm is -1 מיידי, 0 שוטף, and 10/15/30/45/60/75/90/120 as שוטף +N. These are שוטף+N, not end-of-month+N.
CreditCardType includes 0 Unknown alongside 1 Isracard, 2 Visa, 3 Mastercard, 4 American Express, 5 Diners.
IncomeRowRequest requires description, quantity, price, currency and vatType. PaymentRowRequest requires date, type, price and currency.
Search pagination is 1-based: SearchDocumentsRequest.page and SearchItemsRequest.page both default to 1.
